accepted.match: "archive" defined differently in file-extensions and email-basics
accepted.reason: Reviewed (0% overlap): genuine homonym. In File Extensions an 'archive' is a compressed container file (e.g., .zip); in Email Basics 'archive' is the action of moving a message out of the inbox to storage. Different meanings sharing a word.

accepted.match: "https" defined differently in how-the-web-works and browsers
accepted.reason: Reviewed: compatible treatments at different depths. How the Web Works defines HTTPS as HTTP over TLS in the request-response cycle; Browsers frames HTTPS via the padlock and what it does/does not guarantee to the user. Complementary, non-contradictory.
